same step y=6.876 is just above wall top (6.7), confirming corner-clip geometry

counterfactual.change: reduced initial |vx| from 47.6 to 10.0 (same direction, all else identical) so corner is approached slowly and collision resolves without deep penetration

explanation: High-speed (~50 u/s) body rebounds off left arena bound and grazes the top corner of a thin (0.1 wide) tall wall. The corner contact at ~22 substeps still allows deep overlap (-0.32) because discrete impulse plus positional correction cannot resolve a fast corner graze within tolerance; slowing the approach removes the failure.
vision_note: The red body drifts rightward toward the top tip of the thin vertical wall from steps 2 to 4. By step 5 it ends up centered directly on the wall tip, visibly overlapping the corner.
